title: Pure Code Talker
summary: Code Talker cards with generic Cyberse monsters and staples. The page's starters come from the Firewall and Mathmech engines, and Splash Mage is Forbidden, so those lines use cards this list leaves out. The Code main-deck monsters can be Link Material straight from the hand, and each pays you back when it goes to the GY for a Code Talker: Micro Coder searches Cynet Codec, which then searches a Cyberse monster of each new Code Talker's Attribute. The generic Cyberses fill the Attributes the archetype is missing: Backup Secretary for LIGHT and Flame Bufferlo for FIRE. Decode Talker Integration, the newest Code Talker, is one of the Link-3s. Protectcode Talker is Forbidden.
